guitar.modelsText: Gibson SG Special / Rickenbacker / Fender Stratocaster / Gibson J-200
guitar.evidence: Pete Townshend's Gibson SG Special (smashed on stage, used on Live at Leeds) and earlier Rickenbackers are extremely well documented; deserves high rather than medium confidence given how iconic his windmill/SG combo is.
guitar.notes: Upgraded confidence from medium to high.

tone.target: big dry British crunch with biting upper mids
tone.profile: big dry British crunch with biting upper mids
tone.summary: A tight signal chain using a Boost for initial attack, followed by an OD pedal to shape the crunch, feeding into a classic UK amp model (UK 45) with a dry cabinet, enhanced by Chorus and a solo Wah effect.

rig.name: The Who - Won't Get Fooled Again - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and tighten the rhythm playing.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for rock tones.
